description: This is the main entry point for a Vue 3 application, responsible for setting up the app, incorporating state management with Pinia, routing, and mounting the app to the DOM.

methods.name: app.use
methods.description: Registers plugins (Pinia and router) with the Vue application instance.

methods.name: app.mount
methods.description: Mounts the Vue application to the DOM element with id 'app'.
